{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "norm_neg",
      "informal_name": "Norm of Negation Equals Norm",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedAddGroup E] (a : E), ‖-a‖ = ‖a‖",
      "informal_description": "For any element $ a $ in a seminormed additive group, the norm of $ -a $ is equal to the norm of $ a $, i.e., $ \\| -a \\| = \\| a \\| $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Group.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "nnnorm_neg",
      "informal_name": "Norm of Negative Element in Seminormed Additive Group",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedAddGroup E] (a : E), ‖-a‖₊ = ‖a‖₊",
      "informal_description": "For any element $ a $ in a seminormed additive group $ E $, the non-negative norm of $ -a $ equals the non-negative norm of $ a $, i.e., $ \\|-a\\|_+ = \\|a\\|_+ $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Group.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "enorm_neg",
      "informal_name": "Extended Norm of Negation Equals Extended Norm",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedAddGroup E] (a : E), ‖-a‖ₑ = ‖a‖ₑ",
      "informal_description": "For any element $a$ in a seminormed additive group $E$, the extended norm of $-a$ is equal to the extended norm of $a$, i.e., $\\| -a \\|_\\mathrm{e} = \\| a \\|_\\mathrm{e}$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Group.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "FreeAddGroup.norm_neg_eq",
      "informal_name": "Norm of Negation Equals Norm: $\\| -x \\| = \\| x \\|$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {x : FreeAddGroup α}, (-x).norm = x.norm",
      "informal_description": "For any element $x$ in the free abelian group over a type $\\alpha$ with decidable equality, the norm of the additive inverse of $x$ is equal to the norm of $x$, i.e., $\\| -x \\| = \\| x \\|$. The norm is defined as the sum of the absolute values of coefficients in the reduced representation of the element.",
      "path": "Mathlib.GroupTheory.FreeGroup.Reduce"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Module.Basis.norm_neg",
      "informal_name": "Norm of Negative Element Equals Norm in Basis-Induced Module",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : NormedField K] [inst_1 : Ring L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {ι : Type u_3}\n  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] [inst_4 : Nonempty ι] (B : Module.Basis ι K L) (x : L), B.norm (-x) = B.norm x",
      "informal_description": "For any element $x$ in the module $L$, the norm of $-x$ induced by the basis $B$ is equal to the norm of $x$, i.e., $\\| -x \\| = \\| x \\|$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Unbundled.FiniteExtension"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "NormedAddGroupHom.opNorm_neg",
      "informal_name": "Operator Norm of Negated Homomorphism Equals Original",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {V₁ : Type u_2} {V₂ : Type u_3} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup V₁] [inst_1 : SeminormedAddCommGroup V₂]\n  (f : NormedAddGroupHom V₁ V₂), ‖-f‖ = ‖f‖",
      "informal_description": "For any normed additive group homomorphism $ f : V_1 \\to V_2 $ between seminormed additive commutative groups $ V_1 $ and $ V_2 $, the operator norm of the negation $-f$ is equal to the operator norm of $ f $, i.e., $\\| -f \\| = \\| f \\|$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Group.Hom"
    }
  ]
}

items.informal_description: For any element $ a $ in a seminormed additive group, the norm of $ -a $ is equal to the norm of $ a $, i.e., $ \| -a \| = \| a \| $.

items.informal_name: Norm of Negative Element in Seminormed Additive Group
items.informal_description: For any element $ a $ in a seminormed additive group $ E $, the non-negative norm of $ -a $ equals the non-negative norm of $ a $, i.e., $ \|-a\|_+ = \|a\|_+ $.

items.informal_name: Extended Norm of Negation Equals Extended Norm
items.informal_description: For any element $a$ in a seminormed additive group $E$, the extended norm of $-a$ is equal to the extended norm of $a$, i.e., $\| -a \|_\mathrm{e} = \| a \|_\mathrm{e}$.

items.informal_name: Norm of Negation Equals Norm: $\| -x \| = \| x \|$
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {x : FreeAddGroup α}, (-x).norm = x.norm
items.informal_description: For any element $x$ in the free abelian group over a type $\alpha$ with decidable equality, the norm of the additive inverse of $x$ is equal to the norm of $x$, i.e., $\| -x \| = \| x \|$. The norm is defined as the sum of the absolute values of coefficients in the reduced representation of the element.

items.informal_name: Norm of Negative Element Equals Norm in Basis-Induced Module
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : NormedField K] [inst_1 : Ring L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {ι : Type u_3}
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] [inst_4 : Nonempty ι] (B : Module.Basis ι K L) (x : L), B.norm (-x) = B.norm x
items.informal_description: For any element $x$ in the module $L$, the norm of $-x$ induced by the basis $B$ is equal to the norm of $x$, i.e., $\| -x \| = \| x \|$.

items.informal_name: Operator Norm of Negated Homomorphism Equals Original
items.type:
∀ {V₁ : Type u_2} {V₂ : Type u_3} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup V₁] [inst_1 : SeminormedAddCommGroup V₂]
  (f : NormedAddGroupHom V₁ V₂), ‖-f‖ = ‖f‖
items.informal_description: For any normed additive group homomorphism $ f : V_1 \to V_2 $ between seminormed additive commutative groups $ V_1 $ and $ V_2 $, the operator norm of the negation $-f$ is equal to the operator norm of $ f $, i.e., $\| -f \| = \| f \|$.
